name: perl-class-accessor
description: This tool automates the generation of getter and setter methods for Perl class attributes. Use when user asks to create object accessors, implement read-only or write-only fields, or use a declarative syntax for object-oriented Perl development.
overview: This skill enables the rapid creation of Perl class attributes without manual method writing. `Class::Accessor` automates the generation of getter/setter methods, providing a standardized way to handle object data. It supports traditional Perl inheritance patterns as well as a modern declarative syntax. Use this to ensure consistency across object-oriented Perl projects and to implement read-only or write-only constraints on object fields.
